articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Native Multimodal Reasoning and Extended Context
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning across text, image, audio, and video inputs with a reported 1M-token effective context window. Benchmarks show substantial gains in complex multi-step reasoning tasks, code generation accuracy, and scientific problem-solving, narrowing the gap toward expert-level performance in several specialized domains.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Agentic Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Ultra 2 with a focus on agentic capabilities, demonstrating autonomous multi-step task completion across web browsing, coding environments, and enterprise workflows. The model introduces a novel planning architecture that allows persistent memory and self-correction loops, pushing SWE-Bench Verified scores past 75%.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Demonstrates Fully Autonomous Warehouse Operations at Scale
articles.summary: Figure announced that its Figure 03 humanoid robots have completed a full quarter of autonomous warehouse operations at a BMW logistics facility, handling palletizing, sorting, and inter-zone transport without human intervention. The company reports a 40% throughput improvement over the prior mixed human-robot workflow, marking a milestone in commercial humanoid deployment.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Electric Gains Real-Time Whole-Body Manipulation via Foundation Model
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics revealed a major software update for its electric Atlas platform, integrating a robotics foundation model trained on millions of hours of simulation and real-world teleoperation data. The system enables Atlas to perform dexterous whole-body manipulation tasks—such as assembling components and navigating cluttered environments—specified via natural language instructions.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Behemoth Open-Weight Model with MoE Architecture
articles.summary: Meta released the full open-weight Llama 4 Behemoth, a massive mixture-of-experts model with over 2 trillion total parameters. The model is competitive with frontier closed-source systems on reasoning and multilingual benchmarks, and Meta's decision to release it openly has reignited debate about the safety and democratization tradeoffs of open-weight frontier models.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed volume production of its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node, roughly two months ahead of its original roadmap. The node leverages gate-all-around nanosheet transistors and backside power delivery, offering an estimated 20% performance uplift and 30% power reduction over N2, with major AI accelerator customers including NVIDIA and Apple among the first to tape out.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface Trial
articles.summary: Neuralink obtained FDA clearance to begin human trials of its N2 implant, which features 4x the electrode density of its first-generation device and a fully wireless bidirectional data link. The expanded trial will include patients with spinal cord injuries and ALS, with the goal of restoring both motor control and sensory feedback via closed-loop stimulation.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional Classifiers v2 for Real-Time Model Safety Enforcement
articles.summary: Anthropic published research on Constitutional Classifiers v2, a system that runs parallel to model inference to detect and mitigate unsafe outputs with sub-50ms latency overhead. The approach uses lightweight classifier ensembles distilled from larger models and trained on adversarial red-team data, significantly reducing jailbreak success rates while maintaining helpfulness scores on standard benchmarks.
